description: This file defines the UsersLastImport class, a PHP class extending SugarBean, managing user import records in SuiteCRM, including methods for deletion, undoing imports, and retrieving bean types.

classes.name: UsersLastImport
classes.description: A PHP class representing user last import records, with methods for managing import data, deletion, and retrieval of bean types.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Extends ACL helper to determine access rights for account display.

methods.name: mark_deleted_by_user_id
methods.description: Deletes all import records for a specific user.

methods.name: undoById
methods.description: Undoes a specific import record by ID.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes all import records for a specific module.

methods.name: _deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a record and associated email addresses from the database.

methods.name: getBeansByImport
methods.description: Retrieves distinct bean types imported by the current user for a specific module.
